name: Asset Place Landscape and Occupancy View
constraints: Asset Place Landscape is a governed declaration with local artifact identity; Occupancy View and Landscape Projection have no independent domain identity.
Place, site, facility, building, interior space and movable asset retain separate mastership; WM-BLT-002 interior-space authority remains explicitly deferred.
Containment is authored, evidenced and effective-dated and is never inferred from geometry, address or reporting scope.
Occupancy and availability are purpose-bound reproducible projections from pinned record-time inputs and a declared projection as-of.
Placement, custody, title, responsibility, occupancy, availability and maintenance remain separate relations or facts.
Every projection pins source version and record-as-of, disclosure policy, purpose, suppression threshold and digest.
No output refines source granularity; cross-rendition differencing is forbidden; withheld is explicit and distinct from absent or unknown.
holds: Both independent relation candidates remain identifier-unassigned.
Canonical bases, relations, source crosswalks, privacy review and live verification remain pending.
Grok review is reconciled and the single frozen audit is spent and remediated without rerun.
